home.title: Emizannyo n'Ebyokukola eri Abalina Dementia & Alzheimer's | Golden Moments
home.description: Emizannyo gy'ebifaananyi egy'obwereere era emigonvu egy'okuzannyira ku yintaneeti, n'ebirowozo ku byokukola eri abantu abalina dementia oba Alzheimer's n'abalabirizi baabwe. Teweetaagisa kwewandiisa, saawa ebala oba obubonero.
home.eyebrow: Bwereere · Tewali birango · Tewali kwewandiisa · Tewali saawa ebala wadde obubonero
home.h1: Emizannyo n'Ebyokukola Ebigonvu eri Abantu Abalina Dementia
home.lede: Emizannyo gy'ebifaananyi egyangu, ebifaananyi eby'amanyi, n'ebyokukola eby'okusanyukiramu awamu—nga mukozesa sipiidi ebasanyusa.
facts: Kikola ku ssimu, taabuleti ne kompyuta
home.heroApp: Era waliwo app ey'obwereere eya iPhone, iPad ne Android, ng'erimu n'ebifaananyi by'amaka gammwe kyennyini
home.gamesLede: Buli gumu muteefu, gwa bantu bakulu era gwangu okutandika. Mulondemu gumu, mutuule wamu, era mukolagane mu kukoona ku kisaaniiko.

steps.title: Londa ekintu eky'amanyi
steps.text: Ebifaananyi by'ebikopo by'amawayi, ennimiro z'ebimuli, ebisolo by'awaka n'ebyombo by'omumazzi. Tewali kusoma oba mateeka ga kusoooka kuyiga.

steps.title: Mutuule wamu
steps.text: Baleke bakooneko. Mwogerere ku bifaananyi. Ebifaananyi bwe biba tebifaanaganye, kyangu kiba kilinda kukoona kuddako.

steps.title: Mulekere awo nga mukyanyumirwa
steps.text: Omuzannyo gumu kiba kyokukola ekyamalirizibwa. Ebigambo “Kikomekkerezeddwa leero” bibeerawo bulijjo ku lutimbe.

home.stageTitle: Ebirowozo ku byokukola mu buli mutendera
home.stageLede: Ennyimba, emirimu gya bulijjo, okujjukirako ebintu by'edda n'ebiseera ebiwummuliza omwoyo, nga bitegekeddwa okusinziira ku ekyo ekisanyusa mu kiseera kino.

stages.title: Omutendera ogusooka
stages.text: Mweyongere okukola ebyo bye baagala, nga mukolawo enkyukakyuka ntono: ebyo bye balina nabyo omukwano, okufulumako, emizannyo gy'ebigambo n'okuteekerateekera awamu.
stages.label: Ebirowozo ku mutendera ogusooka

stages.title: Omutendera ogwa wakati
stages.text: Emirimu egyangu era egy'amanyi egigabanyiziddwamu emitendera: okuzinga, okusunsula, ennyimba, emizannyo gy'ebifaananyi n'okutambulako akatamba.
stages.label: Ebirowozo ku mutendera ogwa wakati

stages.title: Omutendera ogw'oluvannyuma
stages.text: Okwegumya n'okukwatagana okuyitira mu kukwatako, amaloboozi n'okulaba: okulabirira emikono, ennyimba ze baagala ennyo, ebifaananyi n'okubeerera awamu.
stages.label: Ebirowozo ku mutendera ogw'oluvannyuma

home.specificHtml: Olina kintu ky'ennyini ky'onoonya? Gezako ebyokukola n'emizannyo eri abalina Alzheimer's, emizannyo egy'obwongo emigonvu, ebibuuzo ebyangu eby'okujjukira oba ebizibu by'okukwataganya.
home.approachTitle: Kikolwa kya kukolera wamu, ssi kugezesebwa kwa kujjukira
home.approachLede: Emizannyo mingi “egy'obwongo” gizimbibwa ku mbiro, obubonero n'omuddiringano gw'okuwangula. Eri omuntu alina dementia, ekyo kiyinza okuwulikika ng'ekigezo. Ffe twakola ekikontana n'ekyo.

principles.title: Tewali kulemererwa
principles.text: Tewali saawa ebala, bubonero, bulamu bwa muzannyo oba kuwangulwa. Ekifaananyi ekitafaanana kiba kuwummulamu katono, ssi nsobi.

principles.title: Ebifaananyi bisigala nga byeyoleka
principles.text: Okutegedde kisinga okukijjukira. Okufaanaganya kutandika nga buli kimu kirebwa obulungi, n'olwekyo tewali kintu kye mwetaaga kujjukira mu mutwe.

principles.title: Kya bantu bakulu era ekitiibwa ky'omuntu kikuumibwa
principles.text: Ebigambo eby'ekisa era ebyangu n'ebifaananyi eby'ebintu ebya ddala. Tetukozesa bintu bya baana bito wadde ebigambo eby'abaana abawere.

principles.title: Ebyama bikuumibwa bulungi
principles.text: Tewali kwetaagisa akawunti wadde ebirango. Ebifaananyi byammwe tebiva ku ssimu oba ku kompyuta yammwe.

home.guidesTitle: Obukodyo obw'omugaso mu kulabirira buli lunaku

guides.title: Engeri y'okuzannyiramu emizannyo awamu
guides.text: Okutegeka, enkola ey'akasirise, n'eky'okukola singa omuzannyo guba gukomye okuba omusanyusa.

guides.title: Bwe baba bagaanye okukola ekintu
guides.text: Ensonga eza bulijjo ezibagaanyisa, n'engeri ey'ekisa ey'okugezako nate oluvannyuma.

guides.title: Okutegeka taabuleti
guides.text: Ennukuta enneneeko, ebitaataaganya ebitono, n'olutimbe olukulu olwangu era olulambulukufu.

guides.title: Ebyokukola eby'obwereere ebisobola okukubiswa
guides.text: Okunoonya ebigambo mu nnukuta ennene, empapula z'okusiiga langyi, bingo n'ebipande ebitandika emboozi.

home.researchTitle: Obulamu bw'obwongo: kiki okunoonyereza kye kugamba ddala
home.researchText: Dementia eyinza okuziyizibwa? Emizannyo gy'obwongo girina kye giyamba? Ate eby'okusiiba, emmere, otulo n'okuwulira obulungi? Ebyokuddamu ebyangu era ebiriko ensibuko, nga mw'otwalidde n'awo obukakafu we bulabikira nga bunafu.
home.appTitle: Golden Moments ku iPhone, iPad ne Android
home.appText: App eno ey'obwereere ekola n'awatali yintaneeti era esobola okukozesa ebifaananyi by'amaka gammwe bye mulonzeeko, ebikuumibwa ku ssimu yammwe. Entegeka y'emu eteefu: obupande bunene buna, tewali saawa ebala, tewali bubonero.

faq.q: Mizannyo ki emirungi eri abantu abalina dementia?
faq.a: Emizannyo emirungi giba myangu, gimanyiddwa bulungi era nga tegiriiko puleesa yonna: ebifaananyi ebinene eby'okugatta, okusengeka, emizannyo gy'ennyingo egyangu (jigsaws), okumaliriza engero ezimanyiddwa, okusiiga langi, bingo ey'ebifaananyi, n'obukada obw'okunyumyamu. Ekyokulondako ekisinga obulungi kye kyo omuntu ky'anyumirwa leero. Weewale ebipima obudde, obubonero, oba ekintu kyonna ekiwulikika ng'ekigezo.

faq.q: Emizannyo gino egy'abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira gya bwereere?
faq.a: Yee. Buli muzannyo n'ekipapula eky'okukuba ku Golden Moments bya bwereere, nga tewali kuteekawo akawunti, kwewandiisa, oba kussaamu kintu kyonna. Emizannyo gikolera butereevu ku mukutu gwa yintaneeti ku ssimu, tabuleeti, oba kompyuta.

Tewali muzannyo gulagiddwaako nti guziyiza obulwadde bw'okwerabira, era ne Golden Moments tegamba nti ejjanjaba oba eziyiza ekintu kyonna. Emizannyo gyaffe giriwo lwa kwesiima n'okumalira awamu ebiseera. Ekitundu kyaffe eky'obulamu bw'obwongo kinnyonnyola ebyo okunoonyereza kye kulaga n'ekyo kye kutalaga.

faq.q: Emizannyo gino gisaanira omuntu alina ekirwadde kya Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Yee. Obulwadde bwa Alzheimer's bwe bumu ku businga okuleeta obulwadde bw'okwerabira, era emizannyo gyateekebwateekebwa nga bwe gisaana: ebifaananyi ebinene ebisigala nga birabika, ebyokulondako bitono, era nga tewali kintu kya kwijukira oba kusobyako. Okugatta ebifaananyi, okusengeka, n'okumaliriza engero ezimanyiddwa beesigama ku kumanya okw'edda okusinga okuyiga ebipya.

faq.q: Omuntu ali mu ddala ery'oluvannyuma ery'obulwadde bw'okwerabira asobola okukozesa emirimu gino?
faq.a: Ebiseera ebisinga, yee, ng'alina omuntu amuli ku lusegere. Tandika n'okusanga ebifaanaganye ebirimu ebifaananyi bibiri, emigogo gy'ebifaananyi n'obutundu bunna, olupapula lw'okusiigako langi, oba okuwummulamu mu kussa obulungi mu bakkakkamu. Kikuume nga kya kiseera kitono, goberera engeri gye bawuliramu, era mukome awo nga bamaze okukoowa oba okukkuta.

faq.q: Ebikwata ku nze bikuumibwa mu kyama?
faq.a: Omukutu guno tegulina bwakawunti era tegulina birango. Tukozesa Google Analytics okutegeera empapula ezikyalirwa. Ebifaananyi by'olonda ku migogo gy'ebifaananyi birabikira mu pulogulaamu yo ey'omutimbagano gyokka era tebisaasanyizibwako wadde okuteekebwa ku mutimbagano.

Golden Moments kibiina kitono eky'abantu abakola emirimu gy'ebifaananyi egy'abakulu egy'emirembe eri amaka n'abalabirira abalala, ku mutimbagano n'akayapuli aka bwereere. Tetuli basawo, era tewali kintu kyonna wano eky'okutwalibwa ng'amagezi ag'obusawo.

playCta.title: Mwetegekedde omuzannyo ogw'empole?
playCta.text: Ebifaananyi ebinene, tewali kubala budde, tewali bubonero era tewali kwewandiisa. Zannyira awamu mu pulogulaamu yo ey'omutimbagano.

appCta.title: Genda n'emizannyo gino buli w'oba
appCta.text: Akayapuli aka Golden Moments aka bwereere aka iPhone, iPad ne Android: obufaananyi obunene, emizannyo egirimu ebifaananyi by'amaka go, n'ebibinja by'ebifaananyi ebikola nga tewali Wi‑Fi. Tewali akawunti, birango, kubala budde oba bubonero.

activities.label: Emirimu
activities.title: Emirimu gy'Abantu Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira
activities.seo: Emirimu gy'Abantu Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira: Ebirowozo Okusinziira ku Mutendera
activities.description: Ebirowozo by'emirimu eri abantu abawangaala n'obulwadde bw'okwerabira ku buli mutendera: ennyimba, okujjukiriziganya eby'edda, emirimu gy'awaka egya bulijjo, obubanja obw'okuwuliriza, emikono, ebweru, n'ebipapula eby'okukuba ebya bwereere.
activities.lede: Omulimu ogw'amakulu kye kintu kyonna ekireeta obubeezi, ekigendererwa, oba akaseera k'okukwatagana obulungi. Tandika n'ekyo omuntu kye yanyumirwanga bulijjo, era okikwanye n'embeera ey'akakano.

caregiving.label: Okulabirira
caregiving.title: Obulagirizi ku Kulabirira
caregiving.seo: Obulagirizi ku Kulabirira Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira: Obuyambi obw'Amakulu Obwa Bulijjo
caregiving.description: Obulagirizi obulungi era obw'omugaso eri abalabirira abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira: okuzannyira awamu emizannyo, empuliziganya, okugaana, okutabulwa mu kawungeezi, obutabuleti, okulonda obuyapuli, n'okwerabirira wekka.
caregiving.lede: Obuyambi obwangu era obukola obw'ebiseera bya bulijjo eby'okulabirira omuntu awangaala n'obulwadde bw'okwerabira, omuli n'okwerabirira wekka.

brain-health.label: Obulamu bw'obwongo
brain-health.title: Obulamu bw'Obwongo: Okunoonyereza Kye Kugamba
brain-health.seo: Obulamu bw'Obwongo n'Akatyabaga k'Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira: Okunoonyereza Kye Kugamba
brain-health.description: Obulwadde bw'okwerabira buyinza okuziyizibwa? Obulagirizi obw'amazima era obwesigamiziddwa ku bujulizi ku bintu ebireeta akatyabaga, emizannyo gy'obwongo, okusiiba, emmere, okukola dduyiro, otulo, okuwulira, n'obubonero obusooka obw'okwerinda.
brain-health.lede: Okunoonyereza okunene kye kulaga mu butuufu ku kukendeeza obulabe bw'obulwadde bw'okwerabira, nga kinyonnyoddwa mu ngeri ennyangu, omuli n'ebitundu obujulizi gye bukyali obunafu oba obutali bumu. Buno bubaka bwa bulijjo, si magezi ga kisawo.

guide.sourcesNote: Tussaako ebiwandiiko eby'ebitongole n'okunoonyereza olupapula luno kwe lwesigamye. Buli kimu kyakeberwa ng'olupapula luno luzzibwa buggya.

healthNotice.title: Bubaka bwa bulijjo, si magezi ga kisawo
healthNotice.textHtml: Olupapula luno lufunza okunoonyereza okwafulumizibwa eri amaka. Terusobola kukutegeeza kituufu eri omuntu omu omu. Yogera n'omusawo nga tonnakyusa mmere, dduyiro, nneebaka, eddagala oba ebirungo ebyongerwamu. Ku bwa kibulankanya obubaluseewo amangu oba enkyukakyuka endala ez'embagirawo, funa obujjanjabi bw'abasawo mbagirawo. Soma okumanyisa kwaffe ku bubaka bw'obulamu.

about.title: Omulimu Ogw'Awamu, Si Kigezo kya Kujjukira
about.seoTitle: Ebikwata ku Golden Moments: Enkola Yaffe
about.description: Lwaki emizannyo gya Golden Moments tegiriiko bibala budde, bubonero oba okwesunsula, lwaki ebifaananyi bisigala nga birabika, n'ebyo bye twogera ne bye tutayinza kwogera ku bulwadde bw'okwerabira.
about.lede: Golden Moments ekola emirimu gy'ebifaananyi egy'abakulu egy'emirembe egyo omulabirizi n'omuntu awangaala n'obulwadde bw'okwerabira gye basobola okwesima nga bali wamu wamu.
about.bodyHtml:
Kyetukkiririzaamu

Ekigendererwa ky'ekikolwa kiri mu kaseera kennyini: okunyumyako, okusemwenyerako, essanyu eriva mu kugatta ebifaananyi bibiri ebigwaanyiziganya, oba okutuula obutuuzi awamu. Si kya kupima muntu yenna, kumukakasa kintu kyonna oba kumupapya.

Ppulogulaamu nnyingi ez'okutendeka obwongo zitegekeddwa ku misinde, obubonero, obutakutuka n'amadaala ag'okulinnya. Eri omuntu alina obuzibu bw'okwerabira, ebyo biyinza okumufaananira ng'ekigezo ky'atasobola kuyita. Ffe twakola ebyawukanidde ddala ku ebyo, era tugoberera amateeka gano:

  • Tewali kugwa. Tewali ssaawa ebala, bubonero, mbalirira y'enkyusa, buwangaazi, madaala gasimbiddwa, byakusanyukirako oba kubala kaseera kakendeera, ku sikuliini yonna.
  • Okwetegereza mu kifo ky'okwejjukanya. Ebifaananyi bisigala nga birabika. Ebirowoozo ebiweebwa bikubiriza kwogera, tebibuuza mannya oba kusoomooza birowoozo bya mabega.
  • Binene, bitegeerekeka era ebinnyonnyofu. Ebigambo n'ebifaananyi binene, langi ezirabika obulungi, n'obupeesa obukozesebwa obusigala mu kifo kimu.
  • Ekitiibwa ky'omukulu. Ebifaananyi byaddala eby'omu bulamu n'ebigambo ebyangu, ebiraga essanyu n'ekitiibwa. Tewali bifaananyi bya katuni, matendo ag'abaana oba ebirabo by'obubonero obuseka.
  • Engeri ennyangu ey'okukomyawo. Ebigambo “Mmazeeko kati” biba birabika buli kaseera. Okukomyawo wakati nakyo kiba kirungi.
  • Ebyama bikuumibwa bulungi. Tewali kufuna akawunti oba birango. Ebifaananyi by'olonda bisigala ku ssimu oba ku kyuma kyo kyennyini.

Kyetutawoza

Emizannyo gyaffe gya kusanyuka n'okussaamu abantu omuvuyo ogw'omukwano. Tegunoonyereza, tegupima, tegujjanjaba, tegusirisa oba okuziyiza obulwadde bwa kwerabira (dementia) oba Alzheimer’s, era tewali muntu asaanidde kugironda olw'ensonga ezo. Bwe tuwandiika ku kunoonyereza ku mpapula zaffe ezikwata ku bulamu bw'obwongo, tunnyonnyola mu bwangu n'amazima we kitatuukiridde bulungi, era tetugatta kunoonyereza okwo ku mizannyo gyaffe.

Ffe baani

Golden Moments kitundu kya bakozi kitono ekikola kyokka. Tetuli basawo. Ebiwandiiko byaffe byesigamizibwa ku bulagirizi obwafulumizibwa ebitongole nga National Institute on Aging ne Alzheimer’s Association, era buli kiwandiiko kiraga gye kyaggyibwa. Soma engeri gye tuwandiikamu n'okwekebejja empapula zaffe.

Tubuulire ekiyinza okuyamba

Twagala nnyo okuwulira ekikukoledde obulungi n'ekitakoze, naddala okuva eri abantu abalina obuzibu bw'okwerabira, ab'enganda ababalabirira, n'abakozi ababakolako emizannyo n'ebikolwa ebirala. Weereza ebirowoozo byo ku {email}.

editorial.title: Engeri Gye Tuwandiikamu n'Okwekebejja Empapula Zaffe
editorial.description: Engeri Golden Moments gy'enoonyerezaamu, gy'ewandiikamu, gy'eggyamu obubaka, n'okussa ebyapya ku mpapula ezikwata ku bikolwa by'abantu abalina obuzibu bw'okwerabira n'obulamu bw'obwongo, n'ebyo bye tutalifulumya n'akatono.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Gye tuggya obubaka

Ebiwandiiko byaffe tubyesigamya ku bulagirizi obw'olukale okuva mu bitongole nga National Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance ne NHS, ssaako n'okunoonyereza okwekenneenyezeddwa abakugu ng'okunoonyereza kwa Cochrane n'okugezesa okw'abasawo okukulu. Buli kiwandiiko kiraga ensibuko gye kyesigamiziddwa. Buli nsibuko tusooka kugisoma nga tetunnagijuliza, era tuwandiika ekyo kyokka kye yagambye ddala.

Engeri gye tuwandiikamu

  • Eby'okukola eby'amazima we biri: kiki eky'okukola leero, mu lulimi olwangu era olutegeerekeka.
  • Bwesigwa ku bujulizi: tukozesa ebigambo nga “bikwatagana ne”, “biyinza”, ssaako “obujulizi bukyali bwa njawulo” bwe buba nga bwe bwo obutuufu.
  • Kussaamu kitiibwa: tuwandiika ku bantu abalina obuzibu bw'okwerabira ng'abakulu abakulu, era tetukozesa bigambo bibasoomooza kugezesebwa oba okubaswaza.
  • Tewali biwiiwye: tewali bibalo bijingirire, bigambo bya bapangirire, bakugu abategekeddwa, kunoonyereza oba biwandiiko ebikwata ku bwesigwa ebijingirire.

Ani akebejja empapula zaffe

Empapula ziwandiikibwa era ne zikebejjebwa ttiimu ya Golden Moments, nga tuyambibwako obuyiiya bwa tekinologiya (AI) mu kunoonyereza n'okuwandiika obubaka obusooka. Buli lupapula lwongezebwayo okukebejjebwa ttiimu okugeraageranya n'ensibuko gye lwaggyibwa. Empapula zaffe tezaakebejjebwa musawo yenna oba omukugu mu by'obulamu, era tetugamba nti zaakebejjebwa. Bubaka obwa wamu, si magezi ga kisawo.

Kye tutalifulumya n'akatono

  • Okugamba nti omuzannyo, emmere, ebyongezebwa mu mmere, okusiiba oba enkola yonna eziyiza, ejjanjaba, ekendeeza oba ewonya obulwadde bw'okwerabira.
  • Ebigezo, ebibuuzo oba obubonero obulaga nti omuntu alina oba talina bulwadde bw'okwerabira.
  • Amagezi agakwata ku kutandika, okukomya oba okukyusa eddagala lyonna.
  • Ebirango oba obubaka obwasasulirwa obufaananyizibwa ng'obulagirizi.

Okuzza buggya n'okutereeza

Buli lupapula lulaga olunaku lwe lwasemba okuzzibwa obuggya. Bw'oba olabye ensobi yonna oba ensibuko ey'edda, tusaba oweereze ku {email} era tujja kugitereeza mangu ddala.

faq.title: Ebibuuzo n'Ebyokuddamu
faq.seoTitle: Emizannyo n'Ebikolwa by'Abalina Obuzibu bw'Okwerabira: Ebibuuzo n'Ebyokuddamu
faq.description: Ebyokuddamu ku bibuuzo ebitera okubuuzibwa ku mizannyo n'ebikolwa by'abantu abalina obuzibu bw'okwerabira: mizannyo ki egy'okugezaako, kiseera ki eky'okumala nga muzannya, ebirowoozo eby'omu madaala ag'omu maaso, obulamu bw'obwongo n'ebyama.
faq.lede: Ebyokuddamu ebyangu era ebimpi ku bibuuzo abalabirira abalala bye batera okubuuza ennyo.

items.q: Mizannyo ki egisinga obulungi eri omuntu alina obuzibu bw'okwerabira?
items.a: Emizannyo egisinga obulungi gye gyo egimanyiddwa, egyangu era egitateeka muntu ku puleesa, era omutuufu gwe gwo gw'anyumirwa leero. Okugatta ebifaananyi ebyolekeddwa, okusengeka, ebizannyo ebyangu eby'okugatta ebitundu, okumaliriza eŋŋero n'enjogera ezimanyiddwa, okusiiga langi, ssaako bbingo ey'ebifaananyi, byonna bikolera bulungi abantu bangi. Weewale ssaawa ezibala, obubonero, ne kintu kyonna ekirabika ng'ekigezo.
Yee. Emizannyo gyonna n'ebintu eby'okukuba ku mpapula bya bwereere, nga tewali kwetaagisa kuggulawo akawunti, kwewandiisa, kutikkula kintu wadde ebirango.

items.q: Lwaki tewali kubala bubonero, madaala oba bipimo bya budde?
items.a: Embiro n'obubonero bifuula eky'okusanyusa okuba ng'ekigezo, ekiyinza okuleeta ensonyi oba okunyiiga. Essira tulissa ku ssanyu n'okumala obudde awamu, n'olwekyo tewali kintu kya kugwamu era muyinza okuyimiriza ekiseera kyonna kye mwagala.

Essimu yonna, taabuleti oba kompyuta eriko pulogulaamu y'omukutu gwa yintaneeti ey'omulembe. Taabuleti eteekeddwa ku kuteekako ku mmeeza kitera okuba ekyangu era ekirungi abantu babiri okuzannyira awamu nga batudde wamu. Kompyuta eya laputo eyungiddwa ku ttivi ekola bulungi eri ebibinja.

Yee. Photo pairs efuula ebifaananyi 2 okutuuka ku 6 by'olonda okuba omuzannyo gw'okugattako ebyefaanaanyiriza. Ebifaananyi bisigala mu pulogulaamu yo ey'omukutu era tebitikkulwa ku mpewo wadde okuterekebwa.

Katera okumala eddakiika 10 okutuuka ku 20, era oluusi eddakiika 2 ziba zimala obulungi. Kebera obubonero obw'obukoowu oba okunyiiga era muyimirize ng'ekyali kisanyusa. Tewali kiseera kigambibwa nti kye kigwanidde.

items.q: Bwe baba tebaagala kwenyigira mu muzannyo?
items.a: Wuliriza era osseemu ekitiibwa okugaana kwabwe, era muzzeemu okugezaako eddako oba mu ngeri endala. Okugaana kuyinza okuva ku bukoowu, obulumi, obutategeera bulungi oba obutaba na kyagalo. Laba obulagirizi bwaffe obukwata ku kiki eky'okukola nga bagaanye.

items.q: Mizannyo ki egisaana abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira obutuuse mu ddaala ery'oku nkomerero?
items.a: Ebireeta ekiwummulo n'eby'okukwatako: okuwuliriza ennyimba ze baagala, okubakwasa mu ngalo n'ebizigo, okutunulira awamu ebifaananyi, okukwata ku bulangiti ennyirivu, okutuula ebweru, oba omuzannyo gw'ebifaananyi omwangu ennyo ng'omuntu ali wamu nabo. Obulagirizi bwaffe obw'eddaala ery'oku nkomerero bulina ebirowoozo ebirala bingi.

items.q: Waliwo emizannyo egisaana ebibinja by'abantu mu mayumba agalabirirwamu abakadde?
items.a: Yee. Omuzannyo gwa Picture bingo gulina kaada ezikubibwa ku mpapula n'omulamuzi alabikira ku sikuliini, ate Finish the saying ne kaada ez'emboozi zikola bulungi nga zisomebwa mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka. Obulagirizi bwaffe obw'ebibinja mu mayumba agalabirira abakadde bulaga obunene bw'ekibinja, entuula, n'engeri y'okukikyusaamu okusinziira ku busobozi bw'abantu abenjawulo.

items.q: Emizannyo giyinza okuziyiza oba okulwisa obulwadde bw'okwerabira?
items.a: Tewali muzannyo galagiddwa nti guziyiza bulwadde bwa kwerabira, era emizannyo gyaffe tegiwoza nti gikola ekyo. Okukozesa obwongo nga muli wamu n'abalala kulaze akagaso akatono mu kunoonyereza eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira obutannakula nnyo, naye ekyo kya njawulo ku muzannyo okuziyiza obulwadde. Tuwaayo emizannyo gino lwa ssanyu n'okunyweza enkolagana.

Tekinnakakasibwa ddala. Okunoonyereza kwekuusa ku bintu 14 ebikwata ku bulamu n'embeera z'obulamu ezongeza obulabe bw'okufuna obulwadde bw'okwerabira, gamba ng'okufa amatu, puleesa ey'omuggundu, obutakola dduyiro, n'okubeera wekka awatali bantu. Okukola ku bintu bino kiyinza okukendeeza ku bulabe eri abantu abamu, naye abantu bangi abakola buli kimu mu butuufu bakyafuna obulwadde buno. Si nsobi ya muntu yenna.

items.q: Okusiiba okw'ebiseera ebipime kulungi ku bulamu bw'obwongo?
items.a: Obukakafu obukwata ku bantu butono nnyo era bukyali buyaaye, era okunoonyereza okusinga kuli ku bisolo. Okusiiba kuyenze okubaamu obulabe eri abantu abakulu, naddala abakozesa eddagala lya sukaali oba abagenda nga bakogga awatali kutegeka, era tekuweebwa birowoozo eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira. Yogera n'omusawo nga tonnakyusa ngeri gy'olyangamu.

items.q: Waliwo ebikwata ku bantu bye mukunganya?
items.a: Tewali kawunti wadde ebirango. Tukozesa Google Analytics okubala abakyala n'okulaba empapula ezisinga okuyamba, ate pulogulaamu yo ey'omukutu ejjukira oba wakoleeza amaloboozi amagonvu. Ebifaananyi by'olonda ku Photo pairs tebitikkulwako ku mpewo wadde katono. Laba ebiragiro by'ebyama okumanya ebisingawo.
Nedda. Golden Moments eriwo lwa kwesanyusa n'okumanya okwa bulijjo. Ku bibuuzo ebikwata ku bulamu, yogera n'omusawo, ate mu mbeera ey'amangu ennyo kubira 112.

handout.title: Emizannyo egy'obwereere era emigonvu eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira
handout.seoTitle: Omupapula ogukubibwako: Emizannyo egy'obwereere egy'obulwadde bw'okwerabira ku yintaneeti
handout.description: Omupapula gwa lupapula lumu ogukubibwako ogw'amaka n'abalabirira abantu obukwata ku mizannyo gy'ebifaananyi egy'obwereere era emigonvu eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira, ogukozesebwa mu bibinja ebibayambako n'ebikozesebwa mu kulabirira.
handout.lede: Kuba olupapula luno olw'ekibinja ekikola ku by'okuyambagana, ensawo z'eby'okulabirira oba okulukwata ku mulyango gw'afirigi. Kozesa ekiragiro kya Print mu pulogulaamu yo ey'omukutu gwa yintaneeti; emmeeza z'ebiragiro n'obupeeso tebirabika ku lupapula olukubiddwa.
handout.introHtml: Ebifaananyi ebinene, ebigambo ebyangu era tewali kintu kya kugwamu. Bya bwereere ku ssimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta, awatali kwewandiisa, tewali birango, tewali bipimo bya budde era tewali kubala bubonero. Mutuule wamu era muzannye nga mukolagana mu kussaako obudde.
handout.restHtml:
Amagezi amatono

  • Londa ekiseera ky'olunaku omuntu gw'olabirira w'awulirira obulungi ennyo.
  • Tandika n'enkwatagana esinga obwangu. Obupande buna bumala obulungi.
  • Munyuumye ku bifaananyi ebyo. Emboozi etera okuba ekitundu ekisinga obulungi.
  • Muyimirize nga kikyali kisanyusa. Okukomekkereza amangu kiba kirungi nnyo.

Ebirala ebiri ku mukutu guno

  • Ebintu eby'obwereere eby'okukuba ku mpapula: okunoonya ebigambo mu nnukuta ennene, empapula ez'okusiiga langi, kaada ez'emboozi ne Picture bingo.
  • Ebirowoozo by'emizannyo ku buli ddaala, n'obulagirizi ku ngeri y'okuzannyiramu awamu n'okwelabirira wekka.

Biriwo lwa ssanyu n'okuba awamu mu kiseera ekyo. Si magezi ga kisawo, si kigezo wadde obujjanjabi. Golden Moments efulumizibwa Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.title: Eri amayumba agalabirirwamu abakadde, amayumba g'ebitabo n'ebibinja eby'okuyambagana
organizations.seoTitle: Ebyokuzannya Eby'obwereere eby'Abantu Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira eby'Amaka g'Abakadde n'Ebibiina
organizations.description: Engeri amaka g'abakadde, enteekateeka ez'emisana ez'abakulu, amaterekero g'ebitabo, ebitongole ebikola ku bakadde n'ebibiina ebibeerawo gye bikozesaamu emizannyo gyaffe egy'obwereere egy'abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira, wamu n'ebigambo by'oyinza okussa ku lukalala lwo olw'ebiyamba.
organizations.lede: Buli ekiri ku mukutu guno kya bwereere okukozesa n'abantu ababeera mu maka g'abakadde, bammemba n'abantu b'olabirira, nga tewali kwetaagisa kuggulawo akaawunti, layisinsi oba kusasula bisale. Omuko guno gunnyonnyola ebiri wano n'engeri y'okubigabaniramu n'abalala.
organizations.shortText: {name}: emizannyo gy'ebifaananyi emyangu egy'obwereere wamu n'ebiragiriro by'ebyokukola eby'abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira n'abalabirizi baabwe. Tewali kwewandiisa, tewali budde bubala, era tewali bupya bwa bubonero.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) ewaayo emizannyo {count} egy'obwereere egikolerwa ku yintaneeti egyakolerwa abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira, omuli okugatta ebifaananyi ebifaanagana nga birabika, emizannyo emyangu egy'okugatta ebitundu by'ebifaananyi, okusunsula, engero ezimanyiddwa obulungi, ne bingo y'ebifaananyi eriko kkaadi eziyinza okukubibwa ku lupapula. Tewali kussaamu kaawunti, birango, budde bubala, oba bubonero. Omukutu guno era guliko ebiragiriro by'ebyokukola ebitegeerekeka obulungi ku buli mutendera gw'obulwadde bw'okwerabira, ebijuliza National Institute on Aging ne Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: Emizannyo {count} egikolerwa ku yintaneeti egikola ku kompyuta ey'omu ngalo, tebuleti oba ttivi eyungiddwa ku kompyuta. Tewali kwetaagisa kussaamu pulogulaamu, kaawunti oba kukoppa ku kyuma. Laba emizannyo gyonna.
organizations.printablesAfter: Kozesa eppeesa erya Print ku buli muko.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Emizannyo gy'ebibiina: Bingo y'ebifaananyi eriko kkaadi ez'okukuba ku lupapula n'omuyise alabikira ku sikuliini, ate ebibuuzo n'ebiddwamu ebyangu biriko ebibuuzo 50 wamu n'eby'okulondako eby'okuddamu n'ensonga ez'okunyumyako.
  • Ebiragiriro by'ebyokukola eby'abakozi n'amaka, okusinziira ku mutendera ne kika, nga biwandiikiddwa mu lulimi olwangu n'ensibuko zaabyo. Tandikira ku birowoozo 101 eby'okukola oba ebyokukola eby'ebibiina mu maka g'abakadde.
organizations.restHtml:
Engeri ebibiina gye bikikozesaamu

  • Amaka g'abakadde n'ag'abalabirirwa olw'okwerabira: bingo y'ebifaananyi oba okumaliriza engero ku ttivi ey'omu kisenge eky'awamu, ng'omuntu omu y'anyiga ku sikuliini ku lwa banne.
  • Enkola ez'emisana ez'abakulu: ekifo ekiriko tebuleti eriko omuzannyo gw'okugatta ebifaananyi ebifaanagana nga gutereddwa ku bifaananyi bina, olw'okuzannya okumpi wakati w'abantu babiri.
  • Amaterekero g'ebitabo ag'olukale: emizannyo gy'okunoonya ebigambo egyakubibwa ku lupapula ne kkaadi ez'okunyumyako mu bikozesebwa eby'okujjukiza, n'omukutu nga gutereddwa ku tebuleti z'etterekero ly'ebitabo.
  • Ebibiina ebibeerawo abalabirizi n'ebifo eby'okunyumirwamu n'okujjukiza: akapepala ak'omuko gumu akayinza okukubibwa ku lupapula ak'amaka okutwala awaka.
  • Amalwaliro n'abateekateeka okusiibula abalwadde: akapepala kano kateekebwa mu bipapula ebiweebwa abalabirizi, okufuna ekintu ekikkakkamu eky'okukola awaka oba ku kitanda.

Kye tutakola

Emizannyo gino gya kwesanyusaamu n'okumalira awamu ebiseera. Tegikebera, tegigezesa, tegiwa bubonero, tegijjanjaba era tegikendeeza ku kusensera kw'obulwadde bw'okwerabira, era tusaba ebitongole obutagannyonnyola mu ngeri eyo. Tewali birango, era emizannyo tegusaba mannya, bikwata ku bulamu oba kuteekako bifaananyi. Omukutu guno gukozesa Google Analytics okubala abagukyalira; obubaka bwaffe obukwata ku byama bunnyonnyola ebyo ebikunganyizibwa. Ebifaananyi ebikozesebwa mu Photo pairs bisigala mu bulawuza yo.

Tussa ku lukalala lwo olw'ebiyamba

Bw'oba ng'olina olukalala lw'ebiyamba abalabirizi, oyaniirizibwa nnyo okussaako enkolagana egenda ku {domain}. Osobola okukoppa ennyonnyola yonna ku zino eziri wano.
organizations.linksHtml:
Emiko egy'omugaso gy'oyinza okussaako enkolagana etereere: emizannyo gy'obwereere, ebiwandiiko eby'okukuba ku lupapula eby'obwereere, ebyokukola eby'abantu abalina Alzheimer's ne engeri ey'okuzannyiramu awamu.

Ebibuuzo oba eby'okutereeza

Bwe wabaawo ekintu ku mukutu ekitali kituufu oba ekitategeerekeka, oba ng'ebiri wano tebisaanira byetaago by'omuntu ali mu maka g'abakadde, tusaba otutegeeze ku {email}. Tusaba toweereza bikwata ku muntu yennyini oba ebikwata ku bulamu bw'ababeera mu maka g'abakadde oba abakozesa empeereza zino.

app.title: App ya Golden Moments
app.seoTitle: App ya Golden Moments eya iPhone ne Android
app.description: App ya Golden Moments ey'obwereere: okugatta ebifaananyi okwangu n'obutundutundu obunene buna, ebifaananyi by'amaka bisigala ku ssimu yo, ebibinja by'ebifaananyi ebikola nga tewali yintaneeti, era nga tewali kwetaagisa kaawunti.
app.lede: Buli ky'osiima ku mukutu guno, kiri mu app ekola ne bwe waba tewali yintaneeti era eyinza okukozesa ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olonzeemu.
app.bodyHtml:
Tandikira ku bitono

Tandika n'ebipande bina ebinene n'ebifaananyi ebimanyiddwa obulungi. Leka ebifaananyi nga birabika, oba bibikke singa ekyo kiba kisingako obweyamo. Enkola ey'obuteefu terina kubala budde, bubonero wadde ebibonerezo. Londa ebipande 4, 6, 8 oba 12.

Kifuule eky'amaka gammwe

Londa ebifaananyi by'amaka ng'okozesa etterekero ly'ebifaananyi ku kyuma kyo. Pulogulamu etereka koppi entonotono olw'emirimu gyayo. Tekebera tterekero lyo lyonna wadde okukyusa ebifaananyi byo ebyasooka, era etereka ebifaananyi okutuuka ku 24 mu lukung’aanyizo olumu.

Mutunuulire wamu

Mutunuulire ekifaananyi kimu ku mulundi. Ebibuuzo ebitali bya buwaze biyingiza emboozi awatali kusaba muntu kujjukira mannya oba kuwa kuddamu kutuufu. Okubitunuulirako kwokka kimala.

Kikola ne bwe wataba yintaneeti

Ebifaananyi eby'okutandikirako wamu n'ebitebe by'ebifaananyi byonna omunaana biri mu pulogulamu. Koppi z'ebifaananyi by'oyingizaamu zikola ne bwe wataba yintaneeti. Okulonda ebifaananyi ebisookerwako ebiterekeddwa mu iCloud yokka kiyinza okwetaagisa yintaneeti.

Tewali kwewandiisa, tewali ssaava ezikwataganya bifaananyi

Koppi z'ebifaananyi by'amaka zisigala mu pulogulamu ku kyuma kyo. Osobola okuggyamu koppi zino awatali kusazaamu bifaananyi byo ebyasooka. Kookopi z'okukuuma ebyuma ziyinza okubaamu data wa pulogulamu eno. Soma enkola y'obukuumi bw'ebikwata ku bakozesa, era obuyambi bwa pulogulamu bukulaga buli mutendera.
app.disclaimer: Golden Moments eriwo lwa kwesanyusa n'okunyumyamu wamu. Tesobola kukebera, kujjanjaba, kuziyiza wadde okupima obulwadde bw'okwerabira oba obwa Alzheimer.

faq.a: Okugatta ebifaananyi ebigwaŋŋana ng'okozesa ebipande bina kye kisinga obuteefu okutandikirako. Singa okulonda wakati w'ebifaananyi kiba kizibu nnyo, gezaako Noonya ekifaanagana n'ebifaananyi bibiri. Bwe muba ekibinja, mugezeko Bingo y'ebifaananyi.

faq.q: Emizannyo gino gikola ku iPad oba ku ssimu?
faq.a: Ye. Buli muzannyo gukola mu mukutu gw'akalombolombo ku masimu, ku tablet ne ku kompyuta, era ebifaananyi byegaziya ne bijjula essiikirini. Okuteeka tablet ku kintu ekiyimiridde kye kitera okuba ekiwummuliza ennyo eri abantu babiri.

faq.q: Emizannyo gino mirungi eri omuntu alina obulwadde bwa Alzheimer?
faq.a: Ye. Gyakolebwa olw'abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira, omuli ne Alzheimer, ekisinga okubuleeta. Ebifaananyi bisigala nga birabika, eriyo eby'okulondako bitono nnyo, era tewali kubala budde wadde bubonero, n'olwekyo emizannyo gino gisinzira ku kutegeera bintu ebimanyiddwa mu kifo ky'okujjukira ebipya.

Gino mizannyo gya kugatta n'ebifaananyi buli mukadde gy'asobola okunyumirwa, naye tegakolebwa kukebera birowoozo oba nzijukira: mu kuteeka ebifaananyi wamu, ebifaananyi bisigala nga bitunudde waggulu okuggyako nga weerondedde okubibikka. Ekirungamya kyaffe eky'emizannyo gy'okujjukira egy'abakadde abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira kinnyonnyola engeri y'okukuumamu omuzannyo gwonna nga mwangu era nga muteefu.

faq.q: Waliyo emizannyo egy'ebibinja mu maka g'abakadde abalabirirwa?
faq.a: Ye. Bingo y'ebifaananyi erina kaada z'osobola okukubisa ku lupapula n'omukozi alabika ku ssiikirini, era Maliriza olugero ne Kaada z'okunyumyamu zikola bulungi nnyo nga zisomeddwa mu ddoboozi erivuga eri ekibinja.

faq.q: Waliyo pulogulamu y'emirimu n'emizannyo egy'abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira?
faq.a: Ye. Golden Moments (eragiddwa nga "{storeName}") ya bwereere ku App Store ne Google Play. Ewaayo enkola ey'obuteefu ey'okugatta ebifaananyi n'ebipande ebinene, emizannyo gy'ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olondawo, n'ebitebe by'ebifaananyi ebikola awatali yintaneeti.

faq.q: Pulogulamu ya Golden Moments ya bwereere?
faq.a: Ye. Ya bwereere okugiwanula, tewali birango, kwewandiisa wadde okugula ebintu munda mu pulogulamu.

Ye. Ebifaananyi eby'okutandikirako n'ebitebe by'ebifaananyi byonna omunaana biri mu pulogulamu, era ebifaananyi by'amaka bikola awatali yintaneeti kasita biba nga bimaze okukoppebwa mu pulogulamu. Okulonda ekifaananyi ekiterekeddwa mu iCloud yokka kiyinza okwetaagisa yintaneeti.

faq.q: Eno pulogulamu ey'okutendeka obwongo oba okupima obusobozi bw'okujjukira?
faq.a: Nedda. Golden Moments eriwo lwa ssanyu n'okumalira ebiseera awamu. Terina bubonero wadde okupima kwonna, era tekebera, tezijjanjaba, teziyiza wadde okupima obuzibu obw'okwerabira obwa dementia oba obulwadde bwa Alzheimer’s.

gameFaqYes.a: Ye. Pulogulamu ya bwereere eya Golden Moments ey'oku iPhone, iPad ne Android erina omukolo gwe gumu ogw'okugatta ebifaananyi eby'emirembe, esobola okukozesa ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olonda, era ekola ne bwe waba tewali yintaneeti. Tewali kwetaagisa akawunti, birango wadde obubonero.

gameFaqNo.a: Si gwa muzannyo guno. Pulogulamu ya bwereere eya Golden Moments ey'oku iPhone, iPad ne Android erina omukolo ogw'okugatta ebifaananyi eby'emirembe nga guli ku bufo obunene n'ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olonda, era ekola ne bwe waba tewali yintaneeti. Omuzannyo guno gusigala gwa bwereere wano mu browser yo.

gamePage.noscript: Omuzannyo guno gwetaaga okussaako JavaScript mu browser yo. Amagezi agali wansi gakola ne bwe waba teeriiko.
gamePage.newToPlayingHtml: Ono gwe mulundi gwo ogusoose okuzannya n'omuntu alina obuzibu obw'okwerabira? Soma engeri y'okuzannyiramu emizannyo awamu, nga mw'otwalidde n'eky'okukola singa baggwaamu obwagazi.
gamePage.appText: Pulogulamu ya bwereere eya Golden Moments erina omukolo ogw'okugatta ebifaananyi eby'emirembe nga guli ku bufo obunene n'ebifaananyi by'amaka go byennyini, era ekola nga tewali Wi‑Fi. iPhone, iPad ne Android.
gamePage.photoAppText: Mu pulogulamu ya bwereere eya Golden Moments, ebifaananyi by'olonda bisigala ku kyuma kyo okutuusa ekiseera ekirala, era emizannyo gikola nga tewali Wi‑Fi. iPhone, iPad ne Android.
gamePage.goodToKnowText: Omuzannyo guno guliwo lwa ssanyu n'okumalira ebiseera awamu. Tegukebera, tegupima wadde okujjanjaba kintu kyonna.
